WEBVTT


00:00:00.020 --> 00:00:01.540
Your tariffs are illegal. They're not.

00:00:01.541 --> 00:00:03.461
The president can charge whatever country he wants.

00:00:03.462 --> 00:00:05.021
But he used this law to implement them

00:00:05.022 --> 00:00:06.301
and didn't have the power to do so.

00:00:06.302 --> 00:00:08.181
Fine. Then I'll do new tariffs under different laws.

00:00:08.182 --> 00:00:10.261
A 10% global tariff, effective immediately.
